title: Great little fan.
text:
Great little fan.. This little fan is great! Due to my lack of reading instructions or even further looking at the fan, I thought it didn't work because it would come on and go right off. There is a switch on the side that actually turns it on. I thought since it started turning and stopped that there was something wrong with it. Look for the switch on yours, while laughing at me!

Bonus is that you can charge your phone with your usb cord right int the fan.

product_metadata.title: Treva 10 inch Rechargeable Portable Fan Smart Power Air Circulator. Plug-In AC Adapter and Battery Powered, USB Charging Port, For Camping Travel and Indoors Use
features: ENERGY EFFICIENT COOLING: Smart Power technology automatically selects lowest cost power option so it won’t run out of power quickly. Desktop battery powered fan tilts for oscillating air flow.
USB POWER PORT FOR SMART PHONES: With a USB power port you can charge your cell phone, laptop, and other mobile devices. This comes in handy during a power outage or emergency.
POWERFUL 10-INCH BLADES: Treva by O2COOL wireless and electric fans feature 5 patented fan blades with 2 powerful speeds so you can enjoy your own personal refreshingly cool air.
COMPACT DESIGN FOR TRAVEL: Take cool air anywhere! This portable fan is sleek and compact making it perfect for camping. It features a convenient flip-up handle that makes it easy to carry.
MULTIPLE POWER SOURCES: Don’t worry about running out of power. Fan operates with plug-in AC or DC adapters (included), use 8 D-Cell batteries (not included) or use built-in rechargeable batteries.
